items.title: Python 3.15 now available as a Vercel Managed Image
items.snippet: Python 3.15 is now available as a Vercel Managed Image for Vercel Sandbox . To run a sandbox with Python 3.15, select vercel/sandbox/python:3.15 using the image option in either SDK or the --image flag in the CLI. The default universal image ( vercel/sandbox/universal:latest ) still ships Python 3.14 and is scheduled to switch to Python 3.15 on December 16, 2026. Learn m
